ejemplo.instalaciones: {pistas} courts of its own, changing rooms and a small stand.
ejemplo.descripcion: A local {deporte} club with {socios} members and a school of {escuela} children. We run tournaments all year round and have players competing in the federation's championships.
ejemplo.competiciones: Regional federation championships and the county tournament circuit.
ejemplo.aviso: Example: this is what a {deporte} club's page looks like on ApoyaClub.
ejemplo.avisoTexto: The club and its details are made up. The opportunities are the ones the site suggests for your sport.

hitos.text: A group of friends founds the club at the local sports hall.
We run our first open tournament in the county.
The school passes forty pupils for the first time.

ejemplo.instalacionesPabellon: We play at the municipal sports hall: indoor court, changing rooms and seating for {grada} people.
ejemplo.instalacionesCampo: Artificial grass pitch with changing rooms, a stand for {grada} people and a clubhouse bar.
ejemplo.instalacionesAirsoft: Our own playing field with barricades, a safe zone, parking and a bar.
ejemplo.descripcionEquipo: A local {deporte} club with {socios} members and {cantera} boys and girls in our youth section. Every weekend we play at home in front of our supporters and, in summer, we run a tournament that fills the town.
ejemplo.descripcionAirsoft: An airsoft club with {socios} members. We run open games every month at our field and have a speedsoft team competing in the league.
ejemplo.competicionesEquipo: Regional federation leagues, for the senior side and every youth age group.
ejemplo.competicionesAirsoft: Speedsoft league and open games at other fields in the area.

hitosEquipo.text: A group of parents founds the club so their children had somewhere to play.
The senior team is promoted to the regional division.
The youth section passes one hundred children for the first time.

hitosAirsoft.text: A group of friends founds the club to play at weekends.
We form our first speedsoft team.
We open our own playing field.

instalacionesDe.voleyPlaya: Four sand courts by the beach, with changing rooms and seating for {grada} people.
instalacionesDe.rugby: Grass pitch with changing rooms, a stand for {grada} people and the clubhouse bar for the third half.
instalacionesDe.hockeyHierba: Water-based artificial pitch with changing rooms and a stand for {grada} people.
instalacionesDe.waterpolo: Indoor 25-metre pool, changing rooms and seating for {grada} people.
instalacionesDe.tenisMesa: Our own hall with eight competition tables, changing rooms and a small stand.
instalacionesDe.atletismo: We train at the municipal athletics track: eight lanes, jump pits and a throwing area.
instalacionesDe.natacion: Indoor 25-metre municipal pool, with lanes booked for the club every afternoon.
instalacionesDe.ciclismo: Clubhouse with a workshop and bike storage; we ride the local roads every weekend.
instalacionesDe.triatlon: We train at the municipal pool, the athletics track and on the local roads.
instalacionesDe.gimnasia: Gymnastics hall with a floor, apparatus and a foam pit, at the municipal sports centre.
instalacionesDe.patinaje: Indoor rink at the sports centre, with changing rooms and seating for shows.
instalacionesDe.artesMarciales: Our own dojo with a 200 m² mat, changing rooms and a weights room.
instalacionesDe.running: We set off from the clubhouse three days a week, with a cloakroom and showers for members.
instalacionesDe.paintball: Our own playing field with inflatable bunkers, a safe zone, parking and a bar.

ejemplo.descripcionIndividual: A local {deporte} club with {socios} members and a school of {escuela} children. We train all week and our athletes compete in the federation's events.
ejemplo.descripcionRunning: A running club with {socios} members. We run together three days a week, organise a fun run every year and go to the county's races as a group.
ejemplo.descripcionPaintball: A paintball club with {socios} members. We run open games every month at our field and have a speedball team competing in the league.
ejemplo.competicionesIndividual: Regional and national federation championships, and events across the county.
ejemplo.competicionesRunning: Fun runs, trail races and half marathons across the county, plus our own annual race.
ejemplo.competicionesPaintball: Speedball league and open tournaments at other fields in the area.

hitosIndividual.text: A group of friends founds the club at the local sports centre.
One of our athletes wins their first regional championship.
The school passes one hundred children for the first time.

hitosRunning.text: A group of friends starts running together on Sundays.
We organise our first fun run.
We pass two hundred members for the first time.

hitosPaintball.text: A group of friends founds the club to play at weekends.
We form our first speedball team.
We open our own playing field.
